standard-dialogue-with-an-amulet-of-ghos.npc: I am a holy Knight of the Unicorn. I served under the Archpriest of this place who himself served under the Justiciar of the Unicorn.

standard-dialogue-with-an-amulet-of-ghos.player: You don't look like a knight... Don't knights wear plate armour and wield swords and lances and stuff?

standard-dialogue-with-an-amulet-of-ghos.npc: The title of knight perhaps has a different meaning to you adventurer. In fact, all of the knights of my order are priests who serve under Saradomin.
During my life, I spent my time here consecrating the fallen followers of holy Saradomin. I would perform their final rites before laying them to rest within this place.

standard-dialogue-with-an-amulet-of-ghos.player: I see. So does this place only contain the bodies of these 'knights' who followed Saradomin?

standard-dialogue-with-an-amulet-of-ghos.npc: Not at all. We also provided these rites for all the citizens of Hallowvale. They were mostly laid to rest on the first two floors.

standard-dialogue-with-an-amulet-of-ghos.player: Interesting. So who is this Justiciar of the Unicorn you spoke of?

standard-dialogue-with-an-amulet-of-ghos.npc: The Justiciar of the Unicorn? Why this title is only bestowed upon the holiest priest of Saradomin.
The justiciar I followed would spread the teachings of Saradomin everywhere he went, converting the masses to our religion.
The statue in the north east of this room was created in his likeness when the place was built. I must say though, it does concern me that this is the first you've heard of him and his feats.

standard-dialogue-with-an-amulet-of-ghos.player: Well I've certainly heard of the word justiciar, but nothing about the Justiciar of the Unicorn.

standard-dialogue-with-an-amulet-of-ghos.npc: That saddens me greatly. I do hope that he is still carrying out Saradomin's will.
Anyway, do tell me adventurer, what brings you to the Hallowed Sepulchre?

standard-dialogue-with-an-amulet-of-ghos.player: I found this place within the city of Darkmeyer and that mysterious stranger over there asked me to acquire some Hallowed marks which you and your bretheren were buried with.

standard-dialogue-with-an-amulet-of-ghos.npc: I see. Did you say Darkmeyer? An interesting name, especially when this region is so bright and full of life.
When I was alive this place was known as Hallowvale. Do you know why the queen decided to change the name?

standard-dialogue-with-an-amulet-of-ghos.player: Erm, simply put, the land here is... under new management.

standard-dialogue-with-an-amulet-of-ghos.npc: Hmm, interesting. I wish I could see for myself but unfortunately, I am unable to leave this place. I do wonder if this new 'management' is the reason my spirit did not pass on to the afterlife.

standard-dialogue-with-an-amulet-of-ghos.player: Perhaps so. However, it's probably best that you can't leave this place. I'm not sure you'd like what you'd find.

standard-dialogue-with-an-amulet-of-ghos.npc: I fear you may be right adventurer. The last instruction I was given was to help protect this place from invaders by placing magical enchantments on the statues within.
I admit, I never dared ask who or what we were protecting it from.

standard-dialogue-with-an-amulet-of-ghos.player: If it's any consolation, the enchantments you placed did prevent the 'invaders' from entering. It's only us human adventurers who enter the Sepulchre.
Although we have been stealing some of your stuff... Sorry about that.

standard-dialogue-with-an-amulet-of-ghos.npc: It's not like I have any use for my stuff anymore. Thanks adventurer, your words do lighten my spirits somewhat.

upon-opening-a-coffin-in-the-hallowed-se.npc: You dare defile this sacred place? That treasure doesn't belong to you!
